protocol.question: Does sharing activation loads across IQ3_S gate/up improve the actual Decode NT1 GU dispatcher on this Zen3 CPU?
protocol.scope: GU only,H2560/FF640,64real experts for each21/20and21/42form. Calls native_gu_rows,including selector/fallback,swish and optional selected-route audit. Does not call ExpertPool,quantize hidden states or execute Down. In particular,the newer pool.cpp/pool.hpp/service_profile.hpp are not a measured model baseline.
protocol.arms: Same binary,immutable pre-exec STRATA_IQ3_PAIR=0/1. Three check processes:reference,candidate,candidate with STRATA_NO_IQ256=1. No setenv/unsetenv after startup.
protocol.conformance: Both forms,64experts x4actual Q8_K-quantized finite activations x2validations/process. Compare Decode NT1 against explicit Prefill GGML reference bitwise,finite outputs and guard rows;test Prefill,NT2,NT4 leave new dispatch counters unchanged. Direct producer checks empty/partial/padded ranges,invalid type/geometry/alignment/null/span/overlap/uintptr-overflow,and synthetic finite F16/grid/high-bit/sign/scale boundaries. Inputs immutable. Exactness is this candidate design choice,not a general FP32 adoption requirement.
protocol.dispatch: Audit=1 in both arms;selected calls/rows must match every timed NT1 invocation only in candidate. Candidate counter overhead remains inside its measured entry. Pure producer does not increment selection counters;fallback does not select. Each process is actually pinned to one physical core.
protocol.access: hot:one full expert per pass;stream:64distinct real expert blobs per pass. First GU footprint1.408MB,stream90.112MB per form;requested/logical footprints are not physical RAM traffic or saturation. No model/cache/MTP mix projection.
protocol.repetition: A0/B0/B1/A1/A2/B2 independent processes,2forms x2access x6batches/process. Whole passes until0.35s,min0.25s,max1000000passes. No retries or additional samples under this plan.
protocol.clock: Per-pass clock probe below0.1%of one warm pass. Setup,model IO,quantization,references,input checks and snapshots outside timing. Production GU dispatch and math inside. Keep per-batch wall and process CPU seconds.
protocol.gate: Decide each Down-form/access cell separately from3paired independent-process medians. Repeatable gain if all3candidate/reference ratios<1;no minimum percentage. Format eligible for model follow-up only if both access cells show repeatable gain. Mixed signs remain inconclusive;no changed criterion or added repeats without a new committed plan. Component success alone is not model speed/adoption.
protocol.stop: First source,ownership,numerical,dispatch,timing or budget failure closes that stage as failed;no retry. No GPU test on a failed component performance gate.
protocol.provenance: Main-authored fixture/controller uses only existing Strata and linked ggml references. Official installed LLVM happens to reside under an old external worktree;no XeStrata source,helper,test or build recipe is an input.
